name: Fifteenth-power suspension of a cubic cone

intrinsic.summary: Regular Newton resolution with 16 charts and 5 geometric exceptional components.

dual_complex.convention: Exceptional divisor on the smooth strict transform in the germ over the origin over Qbar.

alpha1.definition: alpha1_j is root j of T^3+1 = 0, ordered by real then imaginary part, starting at 1.

alpha2.definition: alpha2_j is root j of 2*T^3+1 = 0, ordered by real then imaginary part, starting at 1.

alpha3.definition: alpha3_j is root j of T^3+1 = 0, ordered by real then imaginary part, starting at 1.

alpha4.definition: alpha4_j is root j of 2*T^3+1 = 0, ordered by real then imaginary part, starting at 1.

alpha5.definition: alpha5_j is root j of T^3+1 = 0, ordered by real then imaginary part, starting at 1.

alpha6.definition: alpha6_j is root j of T^3+3*T^2+4*T+2 = 0, ordered by real then imaginary part, starting at 1.

certificate.method: regular Newton fan and exact torus Jacobian tests
certificate.description: The map is an isomorphism off the origin. All compact faces are nondegenerate and every maximal cone has lattice determinant one. The strict transform is smooth and transverse to the toric strata in a neighborhood of the fiber over the origin.
certificate.atlas_verification: Strict transform on the owned origin fibre

compact_faces.method: torus Jacobian Gröbner basis over Q
torus Jacobian Gröbner basis over Q

dual_complex.convention: Ambient exceptional divisor in the germ over the origin over Qbar.

certificate.method: regular monomial modification and chart Jacobian criteria
certificate.description: The fan is regular and covers the positive orthant. The exceptional images lie in the singular locus. Each chart uses the original polynomial.
certificate.atlas_verification: Embedded normal crossings on the owned origin fibre

monodromy.method: Euler characteristics on the disjoint parts of the resolution atlas

topological.formula: sum_I chi(E_I^open intersect pi^(-1)(0)) * prod_{i in I} 1/(N_i*s + nu_i)
topological.method: Euler characteristics on the disjoint parts of the resolution atlas

pole_check.reason: Every actual pole has a local monodromy eigenvalue witness.
